additional_info.subject: NOTE TO L3
additional_info.body:
1. Problem Description :
After a successful session on the 27th October:
2024-10-27T18:20:43.500453+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [DCC] DC2: Charging Phase "P07_STOP_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
4 sessions are then tried and none successfully start
There is A→B2 but doesn't go to P00→P01
All sessions end with
“no PLC link” or “PLC link no SLAC”
2024-10-27T18:30:52.135659+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/39781e4d926b[705]: PLC-Error-Flag 'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
2. Action Performed (L2) : Collected all info
3. Charger SW Version: 4.0.11
4. Reason for Handover (L3) : As per PrCh notes
5. Fault history : 136 DC2_CableTempSensor errors from last 4 weeks
6. Log analysis with timestamp : In attach
7. Action Required
Attachement : photos of number of occurrences and EcoG plot of CCS temperature 43.5ºC and 20.7ºC, diff =~ 23ºC
(right click on photo and open in new tab = downloads)
